title: 11 September 1973: the coup, the dictatorship and memory
goal: Tell the events of 11 September 1973 and how they are remembered, ordering them with antes de que and después de que.
grammar: clauses with antes de que and después de que

items: I can put events in order with *antes de que* + subjunctive and *después de que* + indicative.
I can tell what happened on 11 September 1973, attributing figures to the reports.
I can name the main words for the coup, the dictatorship and memory in Spanish.
